episodes.title: Roller Coaster Murder Case
episodes.summary: The story follows about a boy named as Shinichi Kudō that solved a case at a mansion. The next day, on his way to school, his case was all over the news and was being satisfied by that. His best friend Ran Mōri later showed up walking their way to school. At school, Ran remembers what Shinichi promised her, but seems to have forgotten. Shinichi does remember it later, which on the next day, the two went to Tropical Land, a theme park located in Beika City. There a man has been decapitated while they where in the roller coaster. Shinichi solved the case, which after solving the case, he is following one of the suspicious men that he has seen on the roller coaster. There he finds a shocking discovery, but didn't noticed his partner which Shinichi has been smacked unconscious. The man in black gives Shinichi a poison which turns his body into a elementary kid.

episodes.title: Company President's Daughter Kidnapping Case
episodes.summary: Shinichi has been discovered by several policemen, evenly one of them tells that he is a little kid. It confuse Shinichi cause he knows that he is a high school student. He noticed that his hand isn't out of his jacket, which he runs of when the officers where been talking to their colleagues. Shinichi runs towards his home, which he sees that he has shrunk into a elementary school kid. Ran calls Shinichi to his home, but doesn't pick up which worries Ran and goes to him. Shinichi who have reached his house, tries to get in by climbing over a fence, which will not succeed, but sees Professor Agasa. He ask Professor Agasa to get over, but Agasa can't remember Shinichi in child form and evenly decided to bring him to a local police station. Shinichi proved Agasa that he is really Shinichi, which Agasa is surprised about it. Agasa brought Shinichi home, which he has to wear his old clothes. Ran came which Shinichi hides behind his desk. Ran heard a voice behind the desk, and Shinichi sees his fathers glasses. Shinichi then got discovered by Ran but doesn't know that the little kid is Shinichi. Out of pressure, Shinichi called himself Conan Edogawa. Agasa suggests Ran to take Conan to her place, which he disagrees on, Agasa explains that due that Ran's father got a Detective Agency, he can gather informations about the men in black, which Shinichi agrees. Later Kogorō got a kidnapping case which Conan and Ran are following him, Conan's interest is only the men in black. The case has then been soon solved by Conan after hearing the last phone call from the true kidnapper. In the end, Conan is accepted by Kogorō to stay at his house.

episodes.title: An Idol's Locked Room Murder Case
episodes.summary: It has been three days that Shinichi has been shrunk and stays at Ran's place. Conan then goes to school, where he meets three of his classmates, Ayumi, Genta and Mitsuhiko that wants to be friends with him. After school, Conan visits Professor Agasa, which give him a new gadget. On his way to the Detective Agency, he is staring at Kogoro because he was useless for him to find the men in black. A car then stops in front of the agency, and the three classmates of Conan are spying on him. Kogorō later got a customer, but doesn't show any interest unless he noticed it was Yoko Okino which Kogorō changes himself quickly. Yōko tells that she has been staled for three days, which that Kogoro and the others are going to her apartment to figure out who. Ones arrived at her apartment, they see a dead body on the ground with a knife on his back. Later it has been known that it is a murder case, Yōko and her manager Yamagishi where both suspects on the murder case, which later a third suspect has been added, Yōko's rival Yūko Ikezawa. The case later has been closed, containing that it was suicide and the dead person contains to be Yōko's ex-boyfriend Akiyoshi Fujie.

episodes.title: The Coded Map of the City Case
episodes.summary: Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi went to a exhibit of hidden treasure. They find a piece of paper with on there the words "Oro". A treasure hunt begins, while Conan is not interested in the map until he discovered that Oro means "Gold" in Italian. Later they figured out that neo-signs got something to do with and that the mafia is chasing them which they think that Conan and the others can lead them to the gold. After solving the treasure hunt, it was stolen gold which the mafia came and kept Conan and the others captivate. Conan came up with a plan to make them fallacious with succeeded and told a nearby kōban to tell the officers about the criminals they've caught. They told the story to Ran which Genta and Mitsuhiko started to brag about it. Ayumi told Ran that nothing was done by Genta and Mitsuhiko but by Conan, which she gives him a kiss on the cheek, which makes Ran thinks that Conan got a girlfriend. Genta and Mitsuhiko are staring at Conan being in jealously.

episodes.title: The Shinkansen's Bomb Case
episodes.summary: Conan runs into the black-clothed men from the pilot episode while riding the Shinkansen. He investigates further and realizes they only resemble the original two men. Using his gadget glasses and a bug, Conan overhears their conversation about a bomb in a black suitcase on board the train and is set to explode soon. Conan narrows the suspects down to four. Conan realizes a woman on the cellphone mentioned she liked viewing the mountains but her seat was facing the sea. He realizes the men's seats were facing the mountains and deduces that she was the one who met them. Conan, armed with his new power kicking shoes invented by Agasa, manages to kick the briefcase off the train before it explodes. The woman and the two men are later arrested.

episodes.title: Valentine Murder Case
episodes.summary: Ran Mōri and her friend Sonoko Suzuki are invited by Wakamatsu, one of the two guys they had met the other day, to join him, and a couple of friends a valentines day party, to which they agreed to go to. They arrive as well as Conan, who sneeked on to the premises as well as getting caught there. Tragedy soon strikes the party as Katsuhiko lies on the ground dead from poison. Naomichi had originally confessed to killing Katsuhiko, but Conan figures out he is not the true murder, but is instead Katsuhikio's own mother. The mother eventually admits to the crime, needing the life insurance money on Katsuhiko's name, and is put away.

episodes.title: Once-a-Month Present Threat Case
episodes.summary: Ran Mōri and her friend Sonoko Suzuki are invited by Wakamatsu, one of the two guys they had met the other day, to join him, and a couple of friends a valentines day party, to which they agreed to go to. They arrive as well as Conan, who sneeked on to the premises as well as getting caught there. Tragedy soon strikes the party as Katsuhiko lies on the ground dead from poison. Naomichi had originally confessed to killing Katsuhiko, but Conan figures out he is not the true murder, but is instead Katsuhikio's own mother. The mother eventually admits to the crime, needing the life insurance money on Katsuhiko's name, and is put away.

episodes.title: Art Museum Owner Murder Case
episodes.summary: A greedy art gallery owner about to tear the museum down is killed with a sword on camera by someone dressed in a knight's armor.

episodes.title: Tenkaichi Night Festival Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a writer kills his associate during a festival, Conan has to uncover the hole in his alibi and prove him guilty.

episodes.title: Pro Soccer Player Blackmail Case
episodes.summary: Richard is approached by a girl who asks him to track down Jimmy, claiming he used to be her girlfriend. When Conan and Rachel go with her to her house, they help investigate the disappearance of a pro soccer player's little brother.

episodes.title: Moonlight Sonata Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro is called to Moonlight Island by a mysterious client to investigate a series of murders related to the death of a famous piano player years earlier.This is the first 1-hour episode, which was in US split into two episodes.

episodes.title: Ayumi-chan Kidnapping Case
episodes.summary: During a game of hide and seek, Ayumi finds herself in the trunk of a car with a severed head and a bag of money, leaving it up to the Junior Detective League to track her down and catch the drivers.

episodes.title: The Strange Person Hunt Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro finds the missing father of a young girl. Unfortunately, the next day, the father is found murdered and the girl has vanished. It's up to Conan to find the girl before it's too late!

episodes.title: The Mysterious Shooting Message Case
episodes.summary: As Conan's gang fishes on the riverbank, they witness a most unusual sight. Can they convince Inspector Megure and Kogoro Mori of its importance before it's too late?

episodes.title: Missing Corpse Murder Case
episodes.summary: When Conan has to deal with a disappearing body, an oddly similar pair of brothers, and a jaded law enforcement system, everything is helter-skelter!

episodes.title: The Antique Collector Murder Case
episodes.summary: What starts out as a lazy day soon takes an exciting turn when an antique collector meets his end by the edge of an ancient sword. Can Conan cut through all the confusion?

episodes.title: Hijacked Department Store Case
episodes.summary: The Junior Detective League find themselves trapped in a department store in the middle of a heist and have to outsmart the burglars.

episodes.title: A June Bride Murder Case
episodes.summary: While Conan suffers through the wedding of a former teacher, someone is plotting to poison the bride's favorite drink! What diabolical mind is behind this act of evil?

episodes.title: An Elevator Murder Case
episodes.summary: What began as an enjoyable day for Conan, Kogoro, and Ran, who is being interviewed for a potential job as a fashion model, soon turns toxic. A beautiful young lady has been found dead!

episodes.title: A Haunted Mansion Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi explore a haunted house. With strange noises and mysterious screams around every corner, what they find is more bizarre than any ghost ever imagined.

episodes.title: On Location, TV Drama Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a crewmember is killed, a movie set becomes a crime scene! Everyone involved in the movie is labeled a suspect, but who could be capable of such a horrendous deed?

episodes.title: Luxury Liner Serial Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan, Kogoro and Ran are present when the patriarch of a wealthy, dysfunctional family is found stabbed to death on the family's private luxury liner.

episodes.title: Luxury Liner Serial Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Lucas becomes the next victim on the voyage, and it's revealed that Theodore's escape from his makeshift cell was only possible with an accomplice. Amid two-timing and back-stabbing, Conan's on the case.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Woman with Amnesia Case
episodes.summary: During Kogoro's day at the track, he must dodge a revenge-driven ex-con and help a beautiful woman recover her memories.

episodes.title: The False Kidnapping and Hostage Case
episodes.summary: A dramatic car chase leaves two people dead - or does it? What does a diving watch, a sun tan, and five million dollars add up to? Just another puzzling case for Conan.

episodes.title: Pet Dog John Murder Case
episodes.summary: A dog named John kills a college student, shocking the dog's owner and Conan as well! Conan's known the pooch forever, and if he doesn't get to the bottom of the attack, John will be put to sleep!

episodes.title: Kogoro's Class Reunion Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan and Ran tag along with Kogoro for his college reunion. One attendant is found dead in what appears to be a suicide, though Conan is convinced that it's murder.

episodes.title: Kogoro's Class Reunion Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: When Kogoro realizes that the death he's dealing with is not a suicide but a murder and that the perpetrator is one of his old friends, Conan tries to subtly give him hints to help him solve the case.

episodes.title: Computer Murder Case
episodes.summary: A chance meeting with a corporate executive lands Conan in the middle of a murder investigation. A curious cat, a suspicious limo driver, and pile of melted chocolates have Conan wondering who the killer is.

episodes.title: Alibi Testimony Murder Case
episodes.summary: A famous lawyer calls for Kogoro at a fancy hotel asking him to follow his wife who may be having an affair. Kogoro, Ran and Conan then going to the man's house discover that the wife in question has been murdered? Who did it, and how was it done?

episodes.title: TV Station Murder Case
episodes.summary: During a Primetime TV Mystery show, a man who worked at the station was shot in the head. Though no one had come into the room at the time. How was the murder commited?

episodes.title: Coffee Shop Murder Case
episodes.summary: Ran tells Conan she's meeting someone at a coffee shop. Conan suspecting something, follows Ran. Meanwhile, a murder is committed at the coffee shop. Someone still there committed the murder. But who?

episodes.title: Detective Boys Survival Case
episodes.summary: A treasure hunt turns scary for the Junior Detective League. They're lost in the wild, miles from civilization, and two suspicious-looking men are sneaking around!

episodes.title: Mountain Villa Bandaged Man Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: When Conan, Ran and Sonoko attend the reunion of a film club at a mansion in the woods, an ax-wielding, cloaked man covered with bandages stalks them and attacks them in the night.

episodes.title: Mountain Villa Bandaged Man Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: A group of Ran's old friends seek to defend themselves against a deadly axe-murderer. But is the assailant really stalking them from outside of the villa - or is he lurking within?

episodes.title: Monday Night 7:30 p.m. Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a real estate agent is murdered in his condo, the police suspect a well-known dentist in town. Will Conan's investigation vindicate the beautiful dentist or debunk her perfect alibi?

episodes.title: Cactus's Flower Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a pretty girl hires Detective Mori to help her find an old flame, Conan finds out that the man she is looking for was responsible for the death of her fiancé!

episodes.title: Akaoni Village Fire Festival Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a man Kogoro was hired to follow is murdered, he realizes that the victim's life insurance beneficiary is guilty, leaving it up to Conan to find a hole in his seemingly perfect alibi, which has been provided by Kogoro.

episodes.title: Wealthy Daughter Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan, Ran and Kogoro attend the birthday party of a millionaire's daughter. When they get stranded at her family's mansion along with some guests, bodies start turning up after the birthday girl goes missing.

episodes.title: Wealthy Daughter Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: When a beautiful heiress is murdered on her birthday, Conan springs into action to solve the baffling crime. The stakes are soon raised, as Rachel becomes a target for the assassin's sinister game.

episodes.title: Victory Flag Tearing Case
episodes.summary: A baseball game is interrupted when the School Chairman reveals that someone has slashed the cherished Championship Flag! Scandal rocks Shore View High as Conan investigates.

episodes.title: Karaoke Box Murder Case
episodes.summary: A rock star about to go solo is poisoned at a karaoke bar, and the prime suspects are his soon-to-be former band members. As Conan investigates, he discovers that a terrible tragedy is behind the murder.

episodes.title: Conan Edogawa Kidnapping Case
episodes.summary: A lady who claims to be Conan's mother might really be a spy working for the organization that poisoned him! Can Conan escape from her murderous intentions and find an antidote for the poison?

episodes.title: Three Hotta Siblings Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan land in the middle of a murder mystery surrounding the death of billionaire. Conan must face one disturbing reality: the prime suspects are the victim's children.

episodes.title: Facial Mask Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro stumbles upon the death of the president of a popular apparel company. Why would the president be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she was expecting company?

episodes.title: Alpine Hut in the Snowy Mountain Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan, Kogoro and Ran get trapped in a mountain villa when a doctor is murdered. Conan soon discovers that the victim left behind some clues about the identity of his killer.

episodes.title: Sports Club Murder Case
episodes.summary: The rivalry between two divers boils over as the reigning champ is found dead. It looks as if this death was nothing more than a tragic accident, but Conan knows that nothing is ever as it seems.

episodes.title: Diplomat Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan, Kogoro and Ran are joined by Heiji Hattori, a teen detective from the west coast, in solving the sealed room murder of a diplomat.

episodes.title: Diplomat Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Shinichi Kudo returns to the surprise of everyone, especially himself! As Shinichi tries to expose the real secret behind the perfectly sealed room, the rivalry between he and Heiji Hattori heats up!

episodes.title: Library Murder Case
episodes.summary: Having found a remedy for the poison that shrunk him, Conan decides to play with the Detective Boys one more time and spends it at the library, where a librarian has a deadly secret hidden in the books and a murder on his conscience.

episodes.title: The Golf Driving Range Murder Case
episodes.summary: A relaxing day at the driving range leads Conan, Kogoro, and Ran to their next explosive case, as the president of a leading electronics manufacturer meets an untimely end.

episodes.title: The Mist Goblin Legend Murder Case
episodes.summary: A seemingly impossible murder is committed at a mountain temple - and the Mist Goblin is the prime suspect! Luckily Conan and Kogoro are on the scene!

episodes.title: The Mystery Weapon Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a man is found murdered, three suspects emerge. But even if one of them committed the crime, how did they do it when none of them were anywhere near the victim? That's what Conan intends to figure out!

episodes.title: Game Company Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan comes back on the trail of the Black Organization when one of its members is killed by a bomb at a game exhibit.

episodes.title: The Train Trick Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan's got a maddening new riddle: If a train departs the station at 10:30, and another train arrives at 10:35, how can a man on one train kill a man on the other?

episodes.title: The Ojamanbou Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan's on the case when the manager of a cleaning company is crushed by a piece of steel, but he encounters only dead ends in the alleyway where the murder was committed.

episodes.title: Holmes Freak Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: When Conan, Kogoro and Ran attend a gathering for Sherlock Holmes aficionados, the host, who had promised a grand prize for a quiz, is murdered in strange circumstances.

episodes.title: Holmes Freak Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The murderer is still on the loose and his methods have even the most diehard Sherlock Holmes fans completely baffled. The mystery thickens as Conan tries to crack the case!

episodes.title: The First Errand Murder Case
episodes.summary: The Junior Detective League is back on the case when a young boy becomes the unknowing target of a killer! Conan and his friends must use every trick in their book to protect the tiny tot.

episodes.title: An Illustrator Murder Case
episodes.summary: A popular illustrator finds his life falling apart after an affair with a young colleague. Rather than facing his mistakes, he tries to cover them up in brutal fashion. Can Conan see through his ingenious plot?

episodes.title: A Ghost Ship Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: When a boat believed to have been lost in a storm along with a fortune in gold drifts into harbor after several years, its cargo missing, the locals hire Kogoro to locate the treasure.

episodes.title: A Ghost Ship Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Kogoro is framed for murder! Now Conan has to clear his name. Things take a difficult twist for Conan when the two prime suspects are both killed. There is only one place left for clues -- into the darkness of the Pirates' Cave!

episodes.title: Big Monster Gomera Murder Case
episodes.summary: Lights, Camera, Murder! While behind the scenes for the next Gomera monster movie, the Detective Boys stumble onto a murder! Prime suspect: Gomera! It's up to the Detective Boys to see if their favorite monster is innocent or not.

episodes.title: The Third Fingerprint Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a veteran of the police force kills a mob informant during what appears to be a struggle, Conan suspects that he's lying about it being an act of self-defense.

episodes.title: A Crab and Whale Kidnapping Case
episodes.summary: A young boy is kidnapped and it's up to Kogoro, Conan, and Ran to help! Time is off the essence when the kidnapper sends a deadly ultimatum: "No police, no mercy, no time!"

episodes.title: Night Road Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are out to eat when they meet students from Beika University. A murder occurs on the street, but somehow the blood ended up on the wall of a building, the railing of a rooftop, and broken glass of an upper apartment window! Conan is after the cunning killer imbedded in an outwardly innocent mountain-climbing fraternity, desperately trying to hide deadly secret!

episodes.title: Stage Actress Murder Case
episodes.summary: While Kogoro is hired to find out who sent a threatening letter to a stage actress, his old mentor pays him a visit and becomes involved when the actress is poisoned during a rehearsal.

episodes.title: Night Baron Murder Case (Case Part)
episodes.summary: While on vacation, Conan gets involved in a Mystery Tour via Professor Agasa. Someone asks if Kogoro is the Night Baron, a character from Shinichi's father's novels. What is supposed to be an innocent Mystery Tour turns quickly as Conan is pushed off a balcony into a pool. Conan was pushed by the Night Baron! Yet, one more twist happens when someone else is pushed from a great height and is impaled!

episodes.title: Night Baron Murder Case (Suspicion Part)
episodes.summary: The impaled man in a mask turns out to be Tokio Ebara, a computer hacker. There are several suspects related to Tokio, with a lack of solid alibis. The Night Baron appears once again and Ran engages him in karate, but he manages to foil her kick! Conan finds a clue that leads him towards solving the case.

episodes.title: Night Baron Murder Case (Resolution Part)
episodes.summary: Ran suspects the culprit is Satoru Maeda, the only person at the hotel capable of blocking her kick. While Conan begins to suspect this as well, his alibi is solid. Once Conan learns that the wind that blows in this time of the year is a famous one named "Himekaze" aka "Princess Wind", he figures out the murderers trick!

episodes.title: A Stalker's Murder Case
episodes.summary: Ran, Conan, and Kogoro takes a nice morning walk around the neighborhood. Kogoro buys an energy drink called Kasuman, then a person screams out loud and they rush over just to see a man die and a bottle of Kasuman next to him. Was it poison?

episodes.title: The Triplet's Country Home Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan and Ran find themselves embroiled in a murder at a private beach. However, even more disturbing than the brutal death is the list of prime suspects: the victim's triplet sons!

episodes.title: The Detective Boys' Disaster Case
episodes.summary: An S.O.S. message in a bottle disrupts Conan's beachside vacation. Can he and his Junior Detective League friends find the young woman they believe to be the note's author?

episodes.title: The Death God Jinnai Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a killer claiming to be the King of Death sends a threat to movie star, Conan, Kogoro, and Ran must stop the culprit from making good on his warning: At the stroke of midnight, you will die!

episodes.title: Loan Company President's Murder Case
episodes.summary: Mahjong: a game of strategy, skill, and luck - three things that a sinister murderer hopes he has on his side! Conan must stack the clues and place details in order if he is to win this terrifying game!

episodes.title: Conan vs. Kaitou Kid
episodes.summary: Conan enters a battle of wits with an elusive master thief known as Kaito Kid and has to stop him from stealing a precious pearl from Sonoko's family aboard a cruise ship.

episodes.title: Distinguished Family's Consecutive Accidental Death Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: When Kogoro is hired to find wealthy man's childhood sweetheart, a murder takes place right under his nose - and the prime suspect turns up dead.

episodes.title: Distinguished Family's Consecutive Accidental Death Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan and Heiji Hattori's covert investigation continues. But with precious few suspects, one big question haunts the brilliant duo: If the wealthy man didn't commit the murder, then who did?

episodes.title: The Bank Heist Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan and Ran become embroiled in a bank robbery that ends in murder. Just when Inspector Megure thinks he's solved the crime, Conan discovers a hidden agenda that busts the case wide-open!

episodes.title: The Wandering Artist Murder Case
episodes.summary: When the Junior Detective League sets out to help an ailing homeless man, they end up involved in a new murder mystery. They know who did it - but can they get anyone to listen to them?

episodes.title: The Kidnapping of a Popular Artist Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Ran and Sonoko are off to see a concert sang by TWO-MIX. Meanwhile, Conan and the Detective Boys accidentally bumps into one of the singers for TWO-MIX, Minami. Minami takes the Detective Boys out to eat lunch then she gets up to take a phone call and gets kidnapped by two men. In the car was also the other member of TWO-MIX who was also kidnapped. The Detective Boys report it to Megure and then the kidnapper calls.

episodes.title: The Kidnapping of a Popular Artist Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The singers of TWO-MIX were kidnapped by two men. Conan and the Detective Boys were with one of the members and tells Inspector Megure what happened. The kidnappers want a tape that TWO-MIX sang because it had hints that led them to a crime they had done a while ago. The kidnappers want the Detective Boys to deliver it but then later, the kidnappers want Ayumi alone to deliver the tape. In the end, the Detective Boys manage to rescue TWO-MIX just in time for their concert.

episodes.title: General Hospital Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro witnesses a murder in the hospital, but his eyes may be playing tricks on him: he sees the same scene four nights in a row. Things get even stranger when he emerges as the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Ski Lodge Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan, Ran and Sonoko get stranded at a ski lodge with an old teacher while someone is hiding in the dark and strangling the residents in the night.

episodes.title: Ski Lodge Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: After Sonoko was attacked, the words MASSACRE NIGHT were found written on her hand. Conan leaps into action to uncover the truth, but sometimes the truth is too much to handle.

episodes.title: The Kidnapping Location Case
episodes.summary: The Junior Detective League is after a kidnapper who has dubious intentions. There's more than one life at stake if Conan can't figure out where the captive child is hidden.

episodes.title: The Crane's Return of a Favor Murder Case
episodes.summary: Conan and Ran take Kogoro on a crane-watching trip, but the man responsible for the birds' well being is found murdered. The victim's son turns himself in, but Conan suspects the guy is innocent.

episodes.title: Dracula's Villa Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro is hired by a horror novelist to find out with whom his wife is having an affair. Later the same evening, the man is killed in a ritualistic manner and all of the house guests turn out to have motives.

episodes.title: Dracula's Villa Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Horror novelist Stefan Van Croven has been pierced through the chest with a wooden stake. Kogoro is convinced that the answer is right under his nose, but he doesn't know that Conan's figured out the trick.

episodes.title: The Flower Scent Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro is asked to investigate a murder threat against Rika Okano, a respected artist who is up for an award. The threat is simple: If Rika receives the award, she will be murdered.

episodes.title: The Bank Robber's Hospitalization Case
episodes.summary: After Kogoro breaks his leg, Conan stops by to visit and senses all is not right with Mori's hospital roommates. His suspicions are justified when a high stakes game of kidnapping and murder begins.

episodes.title: The Fearful Traversing Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro, Ran and Conan join a client who has hired an assassin known as "the Fox" to kill him to a hike in the mountain to stop the assassin, who turns out to be a member of the party when a guide is killed.

episodes.title: The Fearful Traversing Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan is faced with the task of tracking the Fox, the world's most notorious assassin, after the mysterious death of two campers. Can Conan stop him from killing again?

episodes.title: Snow Woman's Legend Murder Case
episodes.summary: A wonderland of wintertime fun becomes a stage for tragedy following the death of an actress at the peak of her career. But a suicide note and a history of poor health don't always add up to the obvious.

episodes.title: Kogoro's Date Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro's set to reunite with a childhood friend, but what happens is more than Kogoro ever could have imagined. What do an old ink pen, a security camera, and three children add up to? Murder.

episodes.title: The Cornered Famous Detective! Two Big Murder Cases
episodes.summary: Ran becomes suspicious of Conan when she notices that he looks a lot like Shinichi when he was his age. Meanwhile, Conan becomes involved in the investigations of the murders of a magician and a friend of his mother's.

episodes.title: The Farewell Wine Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro is hired by a retiring billionaire to stop his daughters from killing him for the inheritance. When he is poisoned, Conan realizes that there is more to his death than meets the eye.

episodes.title: The Famous Potter Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: While visiting a famous potter, Conan, Kogoro, and Ran stumble upon what they believe to be a suicide - but was it? As the detectives soon learn, looks can often times be deceiving.

episodes.title: The Famous Potter Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan tries to unravel the mystery of an apparent suicide, but how can he prove a murder took place when all of the suspects - including Kogoro, Ran, and himself - share the same alibi?

episodes.title: The Memories of First Love Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Ran and Conan join Asami, one of Shinichi's old flames, on a weekend getaway. When the villa catches fire, Ran risks her life to save her competition. Was the fire an accident? Or is something sinister afoot?

episodes.title: The Memories of First Love Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan quickly figures out the complicated method the arsonist used to torch the house, as well as the motive behind it. But after the case is solved, Shinichi is in for an embarrassing surprise of his own.

episodes.title: The Historical Actor Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: A movie star hires Kogoro to advise him for a role as a detective. But the line between fact and fiction blurs when Kogoro, Ran, and Conan discover they have front row seats to an act of murder.

episodes.title: The Historical Actor Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: As the media flocks to the high-profile murder case, the police prepare to charge a movie star with murder. Can Conan prove he knows who actually committed the crime?

episodes.title: The Mysterious Mansion of a Band of Thieves Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: When Conan and Ran join Kogoro for a trip to Nakamura Manor, they learn of a troubling secret that may link Misao Nakamura, the original lord of the estate, to a band of thieves known as The Goblins.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Mansion of a Band of Thieves Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran attempt to decipher a secret code that promises to solve the strange mysteries of Nakamura Manor. The unsuspecting sleuths have no clue that the goblins they hunt are very real.

episodes.title: Scoop Picture Murder Case
episodes.summary: When a photographer wins an award for capturing a fire on film, it seems like his career has been made - but when Kogoro accuses him of being a murderer on TV, one of their careers is about to go up in smoke.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Mole Alien Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: A distraught man visits Kogoro about his murdered sister, but things just don't add up. A jewelry store heist and a car chase lead Conan back to the scene of the crime as another case unfolds.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Mole Alien Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: A suspected murder, a jewel heist, and a missing body have Conan and the Junior Detective League working every angle to crack the case. Will Conan be able to put the clues together in time?

episodes.title: Detective Club Pursuit Case
episodes.summary: When a killer spies the Junior Detective League on TV, he decides to use them for his own evil purposes. Can Conan and his pals see through his plan or will they unwittingly help him get away with murder?

episodes.title: Cooking Classroom Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: When Kogoro and Ran attend a cooking class and the teacher is stabbed in the back with a very thin weapon during a blackout, Conan realizes that the killer is one of her students and the weapon is hidden somewhere in the classroom.

episodes.title: Cooking Classroom Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: All four suspects had a reason to stab their cooking instructor in the back. But what was the murder weapon, where is it hidden, and how was the killer able to strike in a pitch-black kitchen?

episodes.title: The Seven Mysteries of Teitan Elementary School Case
episodes.summary: Intruders and disappearances lead to rumors that Teitan Elementary School is haunted. The Junior Detective League springs into action, and Conan senses that a few teachers are covering something up.

episodes.title: The White Sandy Beach Murder Case
episodes.summary: Ran and Conan discover a woman's body, and the victim's best friend accuses the Medical Examiner of murder. The Doctor is definitely a heel, but is he really guilty of murder?

episodes.title: Scuba Diving Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan and the gang befriend a group of university students at an ocean resort. When a banded sea snake attacks, a life hangs in the balance! Can Conan uncover the truth behind an attempted murder?

episodes.title: Scuba Diving Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: A young woman is barely clinging to life and every individual in the group of college students is a suspect. Can Conan make sense of it in time? Or will a murderer escape without a trace?

episodes.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: When a vanished mystery writer begins a new story series, his daughter seeks help from Kogoro to track him down. Conan realizes that time is running out when he finds hidden messages in his new texts.

episodes.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The codes hidden within the novel are more complex than Conan originally thought. But how can he lead the investigators toward answers without his voice-emulating tie?

episodes.title: The Naniwa Serial Murder Case
episodes.summary: While visiting Heiji's hometown on the west coast, Conan joins him in investigating a mysterious serial killer case.

episodes.title: The Kamen Yaiba Murder Case
episodes.summary: Reality and fantasy collide! After the Junior Detective League meets a member of the Laser Police - and Kamen Yaiba - a murder takes place right before their eyes!

episodes.title: A Honey Cocktail Murder Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro is invited to a mountain retreat by a former client, but his hopes of romance end when she jumps off of a balcony to her death. Did she commit suicide or was it murder?

episodes.title: The Locked Bathroom Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Mori Kogoro loses his Yoko concert ticket and finds Masayo instead. The detective discovers the two share some common interests: music, Yoko Okino, and murder!

episodes.title: The Locked Bathroom Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: A blood stain leads Conan to revisit one of the most disturbing murder mysteries of his career. Unless he can get through to inspector Megure, a killer could walk free!

episodes.title: The Weather Girl Kidnapping Case
episodes.summary: A popular anchorwoman disappears and the Junior Detective League is called into action! Coded messages, symbols, and wild weather send the gang on a frenzied game of cat and mouse!

episodes.title: A Mysterious Sniper Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Seiji Ishimoto, president of an electronic company, claims he has been receiving threat letters and hires Kogoro as a bodyguard.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Sniper Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Investigation into the minister's assassination continues.

episodes.title: The Traveling Drama Troupe Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: The scriptwriter for the Drama Traveling Troupe's is found dead. Aside from the murder, a disc was also stolen. What was on the disc?

episodes.title: The Traveling Drama Troupe Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The disc is found in the director's room, but it is empty. The Director was knocked out on stage and the treasurer was pushed to her death. Conan realizes only two people had time to kill the scriptwriter.

episodes.title: The Black Organization: One Billion Yen Robbery Case
episodes.summary: Conan meets Akemi Miyano, who has stolen money to free her the Black Organization. However, they betray her and Conan learns more about the existence of the Black Organization with her dying breath.

episodes.title: The Girl from the Black Organization and the University Professor Murder Case
episodes.summary: A new student named Ai Haibara comes to Conan's class and at that same day, a boy's brother was kidnapped. The brother asking the Detective Boys for help, decide to help find his brother...only it leads to something with something quite interesting.

episodes.title: The Indiscriminate Stadium Threatening Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: On New Years day there was a soccer game taking place in Tokyo and the Detective Boys including the new member, Ai Haibara got to watch the game. During the game the TV station was forced to aim the camera below where the Detective Boys were sitting and where the soccer ball was. Then the soccer ball jumped up and deflated. Conan jumps down and realizes that the ball was shot by a gun with a silencer on it. The caller who forced the station to aim the camera also forces them to pay huge amounts of money or else, someone dies!

episodes.title: The Indiscriminate Stadium Threatening Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The police has found one of the accomplices who took the bag of money the police put there. But then with the person's cell phone on, the other person hears what has happened and threatens to kill someone if the police doesn't let his accomplice go. The police releases him and the TV station was forced again to pay more money that was impossible to get before the soccer game ends. Conan realizes that this person has planned to kill someone in the first place and knows he has to find this person before one gets hurt! But with millions of people in the stadium, is it really possible to find this person before the game ends?

episodes.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (Case Part)
episodes.summary: Kogoro and Conan drop Sonoko and Ran off at meeting full of magicians. On their way home, they learn one of the magicians was murdered and hurry back!

episodes.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (Suspicion Part)
episodes.summary: A strangled body appears in the snow, but there are no footprints around it. Is it magic?! As members of the club search the house, two arrows are shot through windows.

episodes.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (Resolution Part)
episodes.summary: Conan realizes the trick behind the crossbow attack and uses Sonoko to solve the case. But that's not all, Kaito Kid is lurking around!

episodes.title: The Disappearing Weapon Search Case
episodes.summary: Conan and the Detective Boys find Ayumi's hairdresser dead, strangled. With evidence, they find out a blue hangar was used, but was likely thrown away. Can they find it before the trash is disposed of?

episodes.title: The Old Blue Castle Investigation Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Professor Agasa takes the Detective Boys camping, but he forgets the tent! As they look for shelter, they wander into a castle. Inside, Conan finds a hidden passageway, but is knocked out by someone hiding inside! Professor Agasa and Haibara realize something has happened to him when they cannot find him.

episodes.title: The Old Blue Castle Investigation Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys locate the hidden passageway later that night. They discover a body and realize the house's mistress has been the disguised culprit all along. Once they discover Conan, he reveals the treasure and captures the culprit.

episodes.title: The Final Screening Murder Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys attend a triple-feature of Gomera during the final day of a theatre before it is destroyed. During the second film, the man is found hanged. The four theater employees become the main suspects.

episodes.title: The Final Screening Murder Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: With a clue from Mitsuhiko, Conan finds out the clue to this murder is the mirrors. Will the murder deduction be the theater's last show ever?

episodes.title: SOS! Message from Ayumi
episodes.summary: Ayumi is sick and is at home with a sore throat. Her mom left the house to go somewhere and a daring thief breaks into Ayumi's house hoping to find money. Ayumi has to warn Conan and the others through her Detective Boys Communication Badge without making a sound since she might alert the thief and that she has a sore throat. Will Conan and the Detective Boys save Ayumi in time?

episodes.title: The Night Before the Wedding Locked Room Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: While visiting Kogoro, Ran, and Conan in Tokyo, Heiji and Kazuha also run into his father and friend, who invites the group back to his home. While there, his father's friend is stabbed in the heart!

episodes.title: The Night Before the Wedding Locked Room Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Heiji and Conan stage an arrest to lure out the real culprit, who returns for the murder weapon.

episodes.title: The Suspicious Astronomical Observation
episodes.summary: Sonoko and Ran go to an observatory looking for shooting stars. While they are there, someone falls from the observatory and dies.

episodes.title: The North Star No.3 Express Leaving Ueno (Part One)
episodes.summary: While traveling via the North Star Express to Hokkaido, a robbery turned murder occurs on the train. The murder feels very familiar to Conan, right out of one of his father's novels!

episodes.title: The North Star No.3 Express Leaving Ueno (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan's mother is on the train as well and he discusses the case with her. As the train arrives at it's destination without the culprit caught, Yusaku makes an appearance to reveal the trick.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story (Part One)
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys visit the police station. While there, they overhear a phone call where someone screams. Once they arrive, a bank owner's wife is found murdered!

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan helps the Metropolitan Police solve the murder and bank robbery. Takagi and Sato feelings are explored for the first time

episodes.title: The Sudden Street Car Stopping Case
episodes.summary: Early in the morning, the Detective Boys go to see a train. What appears to be an accident turns into a deadly distraction as someone falls onto the tracks, but wasn't the one who died.

episodes.title: The Amusement Park Bungee Jumping Case
episodes.summary: An accident happens during a Kamen Yaiba play at the amusement park and the actor is found dead at the bottom of the pool.

episodes.title: The Truth of the Exploding Car Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro goes to visit one of the students he used to tutor, but upon arrival a car explodes in the driveway!

episodes.title: The Truth of the Exploding Car Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: With Conan's help, Kogoro is able to solve the case on his own. He realizes the killer is closer than he thought…

episodes.title: The Mysterious Old Man Disappearance Case
episodes.summary: Ran meets an old man on the bus, who slips a disc into her purse. She tries to find him, but he disappeared! The same culprits kidnap Sonoko and Conan discovers where they are hiding.

episodes.title: Sonoko's Dangerous Summer Story (Part One)
episodes.summary: While on a trip to the beach Ran, Sonoko, and Conan learn there is a serial killer after brown-haired girls. Later that night, Sonoko is attacked and the culprit desperately searches for her camera. What is on the camera?

episodes.title: Sonoko's Dangerous Summer Story (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Sonoko appears to be the killer's target. Can Sonoko be saved in time? Who is there to help Conan?

episodes.title: The Key in the Water Locked Room Case
episodes.summary: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan visit with an old woman and her grandson, but when they arrive he's found dead in a locked bathroom.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 2 (Part One)
episodes.summary: Detective Sato pursues a possible murderer through a building and accidentally handcuffs herself and the culprit to a toilet. It's up to Takagi and the Detective Boys to help.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 2 (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Takagi and the Detective Boys solve the case, but will they make it in time to save Sato before the building is blown up?

episodes.title: The Silent Ring Line
episodes.summary: While traveling home, a group of coworkers all get on a train together, but one of them is found dead. With Conan and Kogoro as witnesses, they need evidence to find the killer.

episodes.title: The Legend of the Mysterious Five Storied Pagoda (Part One)
episodes.summary: While visiting a 5-story pagoda, the manager turns up dead, hanging from the top floor. Is it suicide or as the legend predicted, a murder?

episodes.title: The Legend of the Mysterious Five Storied Pagoda (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan finds evidence that the rope was tampered with. Can Conan solve the case before it is deemed a suicide?

episodes.title: The Murder Floating in the Water Stream Restaurant
episodes.summary: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran are out to eat at a fancy restaurant with a stream that little boats carrying food sail to the rooms they are supposed to deliver the food to. After a while three men enter the restaurant, then after eating a woman screams and Kogoro, Conan, and Ran rush to the frightened women, pointing at a dead person. How was the murder done? And why was the victim in the room he wasn't supposed to be in?

episodes.title: The Locked Room in the Sky: Shinichi Kudo's First Case
episodes.summary: Conan recalls his first ever murder case, solved as Shinichi, while he was on a plane.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Moon, the Star, and the Sun (Part One)
episodes.summary: Professor Agasa takes the Detective Boys to an abandoned house for a day of puzzle solving. But when the clues he hid are found broken, Conan realizes someone is living there.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Moon, the Star, and the Sun (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan discovers an attic in the house, with a dead body. Another man appears and reveals he has been using the house for counterfeiting.

episodes.title: The Disappearing Detective Boys Case
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys are on a camping trip to practice for the school puppet play! However, a serial killer has been spotted not far from the camp!

episodes.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (Case Part)
episodes.summary: Kogoro and Heiji are both hired to solve a mystery in Tottori. A mansion is supposedly haunted by the Demon Spider God and his first hanging victim has been found.

episodes.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (Suspicion Part)
episodes.summary: The Demon Spider God continues to hang people. A note is left saying Kazuha will be hung next, can Conan and Heiji save her in time?

episodes.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (Resolution Part)
episodes.summary: The culprit is caught thanks to Conan and Heiji who hung those he blamed for not stopping his girlfriend from hanging herself, but what did the killer miss?

episodes.title: Venus' Kiss
episodes.summary: When Mouri visits an aquarium, while watching a play, instead of the actress appearing out of the clam, a body floats up from the water.

episodes.title: The Blind Spot in the Darkness (Part One)
episodes.summary: While visiting a doctor at his house, a blackout occurs. When the lights come back on, a man is found dead in the bath tub.

episodes.title: The Blind Spot in the Darkness (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan investigates around the house and finds a timer on the fusebox. Who murdered the doctor?!

episodes.title: The Revival of the Dying Message (Part One)
episodes.summary: A woman is found dead at Tropical Land in the woman's bathroom with a dying message: "S smeared in blood and KIX on her phone"

episodes.title: The Revival of the Dying Message (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan determines the "S" was a dying message left by the culprit and "KIX" is the real message.

episodes.title: The Twenty Year Old Murderous Intent: The Symphony Serial Murder Case
episodes.summary: A man known as the Organizer of the Shadows is shot to death by his three subordinates. Twenty years later, Conan helps Ran and Kogoro solve a puzzle for which the prize is an all-expense-paid trip on a giant boat built for a small number of people. After eleven people have entered the boat, the boat sets sail. Kogoro meets an inspector that he used to work with on the boat and finds that Heij is on the boat as well. After a passenger is murdered, they learn that a man named Saizou Kanou, the Organizer of the Shadows, is on the boat.

episodes.title: The Man Who Was Killed Four Times
episodes.summary: It appears that following the murder of Komiyama, three people stepped forward as the murderer. However, which one of the three is the actual murderer? Katsumata Kengo, Niikura Yumiko, and Hoshino Hariyuki all had a motive, and when questioned by the police, all three admitted to the murder. Katsumata Kengo struck him over the head with a vase after being angered by the man and moved his body into the utility closet. However, Hoshino Haruyuki likewise admitted to murdering the man after being told that Yumiko would never be his by Komiyama and then hit him over the head with... a vase. While at school, Niikura Yumiko admits that Komiyama made a pass at her and came after her at the school and getting frightened, struck him over the head... with a vase. So who is the actual killer?!? It's up to Conan to help Mouri Kogorou and the police solve the case of the four times killed man.

episodes.title: Reunion with the Black Organization (Haibara Part)
episodes.summary: Conan and Haibara see Gin's car while walking home from school and Conan is able to place a tracker on it. Gin discovers the tracker though and suspects that Sherry (Haibara) is still alive.

episodes.title: Reunion with the Black Organization (Conan Part)
episodes.summary: A murder occurs at Haido City Hotel. Conan discovers that the Black Organization is responsible – Pisco is there. In the commotion of the murder, Haibara is kidnapped. Can Conan save her before the Black Organization finds her?

episodes.title: Reunion with the Black Organization (Resolution Part)
episodes.summary: Haibara is trapped in the same building as Gin and Vodka. Conan is able to help her, but the Black Organization now knows she is alive.

episodes.title: The Coffee Shop Truck's Wild Entrance Case
episodes.summary: Conan is at a coffee shop when one man is killed by a truck running through the front. What happened to the other man who was with him?

episodes.title: The Nocturne of Red Murderous Intent (Part One)
episodes.summary: A client hires Kogoro to find his wife's stalker. At a party, a blackout occurs and someone attempts to grab the client's wife.

episodes.title: The Nocturne of Red Murderous Intent (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan discovers Red Nocturne has to do with the impaled man just murdered. Was it the stalker?

episodes.title: The Big Investigation of the Nine Doors
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys stumble on an SOS sign. Is it a false alarm or is someone hiding something?

episodes.title: A Dangerous Recipe
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys stumble on to a receipt with a dangerous combination of items on it. It's up to them to find the culprit in time.

episodes.title: A Cursed Mask Coldly Laughs
episodes.summary: Kogoro is invited to a car accident charity, but a message from the Phantom of the Cursed Masks warns them not to go. Why have so many people gathered in one mansion and what do all of the masks mean?

episodes.title: The Murdered Famous Detective (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro is nearly killed by an arrow while driving. When they arrive at the hotel, a dead actor has just been found!

episodes.title: The Murdered Famous Detective (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Several people are staying in the hotel, but Kogoro thinks it is the work of an outsider. Conan discovers what the culprit really did, using a modified crossbow.

episodes.title: The Unknown Gunshot That Rings in the Dark
episodes.summary: While Kogoro is at a client's house, the woman is murdered. The suspects are the only other guests in her house: her son, daughter, and the maid.

episodes.title: The Desperate Revival: The Cavern of the Detective Boys
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys stumble onto a group of robbers with a dead body while camping. Conan helps the Detective Boys get away, but he is shot in the process!

episodes.title: The Desperate Revival: The Wounded Great Detective
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys escaped and helped the police arrest the gang. Conan goes into surgery after being shot, but Ran suspects he really is Shinichi! Haibara helps Conan divert suspicion.

episodes.title: The Desperate Revival: The Third Choice
episodes.summary: Heiji helps Shinichi by disguising as him to distract Ran from noticing Conan's identity. Ran is playing the school heroine when a murder at school occurs!

episodes.title: The Desperate Revival: The Black Knight
episodes.summary: Shinichi returns to his regular body and appears as the Black Knight to save the case, but collapses from a fever.

episodes.title: The Desperate Revival: Shinichi's Return
episodes.summary: Having returned to his normal body, Shinichi takes Ran out to dinner. Shinichi attempts to make a confession to Ran, but a murder occurs

episodes.title: The Desperate Revival: The Promised Place
episodes.summary: Shinichi quickly solves the case, but his body gives out and returns to Conan before he had the chance to confess to Ran.

episodes.title: The Significant Music Box (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan begs Haibara for an antidote to return him to his normal body, but it is not permanent. Later, a woman requests Kogoro discover the owner of a music box. When visiting their house, Ran and Haruna see an old man's shadow fly by and someone was attacked!

episodes.title: The Significant Music Box (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The family reveals the deceased grandfather hid stamps worth a fortune. Conan and Kogoro help solve the case and find the lost treasure!

episodes.title: The Invisible Weapon, Ran's First Investigation
episodes.summary: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko are out to eat at a café and befriend a couple. Something seems strange about the couple to Ran, so she goes to visit them and learns something unsettling.

episodes.title: The Super Car's Trap (Part One)
episodes.summary: While attending a car show to investigate a death threat, a man is found killed by carbon monoxide-intoxication.

episodes.title: The Super Car's Trap (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan figures out the trick the culprit used to direct the fumes into the car and is able to figure out which of the many suspects it is.

episodes.title: Kogoro Mouri, Suspect (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are staying at a hotel when they run into Kogoro's estranged wife, Eri Kirisaki. Eri is at the hotel with colleagues of hers. Kogoro is upset seeing Eri around another man and proceeds to get drunk. He is later found in the bed of Eri's female colleage, who has been murdered!

episodes.title: Kogoro Mouri, Suspect (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Prime Suspect, Mouri Kogoro, who was found in the room with a dead body. With the help of Conan, Eri, and the police, they use a trick to lure out the real culprit and clear Kogoro's name.

episodes.title: The Tenth Passenger (Part One)
episodes.summary: A man dies right in front of Conan, Kogoro, and Ran while riding on a bus. What does a past murder on the bus have to do with this one?

episodes.title: The Tenth Passenger (Part Two)
episodes.summary: A murder from 7 years ago pops up when people who rode on the same bus start being murdered. Can Conan stop the bus before it plunges off a cliff?

episodes.title: The Black Wings of Icarus (Part One)
episodes.summary: While at a hotel, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan run into some old acquaintances. While there, an actress is also staying at the hotel, but the next morning she is found hung in her room.

episodes.title: The Black Wings of Icarus (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan rules out a suicide after seeing the crime scene, but can he find who managed to sneak into the room and kill the actress?

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 3 (Part One)
episodes.summary: Somebody is setting fires across the city! Takagi and Sato are assigned to the case, but Sato is distracted by something else. Can the Detective Boys help them solve it?

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 3 (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys discover the pattern of arson and manage to find the arsonist, but the final burning warehouse contains a handcuffed Takagi! Can Sato resolve a past problem relating to her father's death and save Takagi?

episodes.title: The Deduction That Was Too Good
episodes.summary: While walking home from the bar drunk, Kogoro witnesses a fight between two men. The next day, one of them was murdered and the other begs Kogoro to prove his innocence, but something about his alibi is too perfect.

episodes.title: The Entrance to the Maze: The Anger of the Colossus
episodes.summary: An opening ceremony for a ropeway built through a giant Goddess Statue on the mountains is being held. After the first ride, tourist company president rides through, he disappears. His body is found dead on the Statue's hand.

episodes.title: The Falling from Mt. Ryujin Case
episodes.summary: A car is rammed off a mountain and seems like a basic case, but the Detective Boys find a code. Can they solve this while trying to hide the code from Conan?

episodes.title: The Water Palace of Five Colors Legend (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan attend a tea meeting at the Aonogi family house in place of Sonoko and her father. Behind the house is a pond that changes colors. When the group crosses the pond to the tearoom on the other side, the headmaster is found hung!

episodes.title: The Water Palace of Five Colors Legend (Part Two)
episodes.summary: What does the pond have to do with the murder? Conan figures out how the killer hung the victim while not being present.

episodes.title: Mushrooms, Bears, and the Detective Boys (Part One)
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys are out looking for mushrooms in the forest. Genta sees good mushrooms on the other side of a fence, which marks the animal hunting area. On the hunting side, a man is found dead.

episodes.title: Mushrooms, Bears, and the Detective Boys (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Bear hunters are in search of a legendary bear. Conan decides to follow the murderer to see why he killed a man, but does not try to harm anyone else.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Retro Room Case
episodes.summary: A murder occurs in a retro hotel room at Dolphinland. Why is there an ice cream bar, candies, pepper spray and a coin-operated television in the room?

episodes.title: Bay of the Revenge (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro has a lawyer client who is receiving death letters from someone with the initials "T.K.". When the lawyer ends up dead and a man with the initials "T.K." was a former client of the lawyer, the prime suspect is found. However, when they arrive at his house, he is also dead.

episodes.title: Bay of the Revenge (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan discovers a clue linking the murdered lawyer, Kensuke Tachibana, and his former client "Tatsuya Kumada", both with a "T" and "K" in their initials.

episodes.title: Megure's Sealed Secret (Part One)
episodes.summary: When Kogoro and Conan are waiting for Ran and Sonoko to finish shopping, Kogoro spots an attractive woman coming out of the phone booth. Conan spots a pen inside the booth, and tells Kogoro. Immediately Kogoro gets the pen and reaches to touch the woman--boom! Kogoro is knocked to the ground. Actually, the attractive lady was Satou-san in disguise! They were trying to capture the person who was attacking ""101 spice girls"". Sonoko comes to join Kogoro, but Ran stayed to get something else. Miraculously Ran winds up in the parking lot of the shopping mall and spots a body by a car--a dead ""101 spice girl"".

episodes.title: Megure's Sealed Secret (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Inspection follows. It is found that the victim had been involved in a car crash a year ago, in the same parking lot. Using information from the previous three victims, Conan figures that the murderer's motive was probably because of the high-top shoes that "101 spice girls" all wear. It if found, then, that the main cause of the victim's car crash was because of her shoes. They weakened the pedal's reaction. After Kogoro and Megure finally get the point (with Conan hinting), they figure out the murderer, but now he's gone! And now Sonoko, wearing a pair of high-top shoes, is stuck in the shopping mall... with the revengeful murderer!

episodes.title: The Gathering of the Detectives! Shinichi Kudo vs. Kaitou Kid
episodes.summary: Kaitou Kid reminisces over the time he was almost caught by Shinichi Kudo. A detective meeting as been called by an unknown person using Kaitou Kid's name. As the detectives become stranded in the mansion, one is murdered.

episodes.title: The Client Full of Lies (Part One)
episodes.summary: An old but pretty woman comes in Kogoro's office, asking him to find the address of her first love. Kogoro gets very interested in her,and Conan quickly finds out the address. Conan is also suspicious about this woman because he noticed that she kept telling lies-- saying that she wasn't married when her ring finger was thinner and saying that she never cooked when she could recognize different kinds of fish just by looking at the gills. But when they arrive, they find an open door. And the open door revealed a bloody crime scene-- the woman's first love lies dead on the floor.

episodes.title: The Client Full of Lies (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The victim is holding a picture of Kogoro's client – does that make her the prime suspect?! What else is the client hiding from Conan and Kogoro?

episodes.title: And Then There Were No Mermaids (Case Part)
episodes.summary: Conan, Ran, Heiji, Kazuha, and Kogoro go to the Isle of Mermaids at the request of a client.

episodes.title: And Then There Were No Mermaids (Deduction Part)
episodes.summary: A festival turns sour when one of the contestants is found dead in a waterfall. Conan awaits Heiji's assistance to reveal the culprit, but Heiji and Kazhua are pushed off a cliff!

episodes.title: And Then There Were No Mermaids (Resolution Part)
episodes.summary: Conan confronts the culprit. A tragic town secret leads to a grave misunderstanding.

episodes.title: The Secret of the High Sales
episodes.summary: A boy comes to the Detective Boys with a case. A new employee at his family's shop is acting suspicious!

episodes.title: The Battle Game Trap (Part One)
episodes.summary: Ran and Sonoko run into their new English teacher, Jodie, at an arcade. While talking with their teacher, a man is murdered while playing video games.

episodes.title: The Battle Game Trap (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Jodie acts suspicious towards Conan's young appearance and good reasoning ability. Conan figures out the game trick!

episodes.title: The Murderous Pottery Class (Part One)
episodes.summary: A man is killed during a pottery class. The culprit is evident, but no evidence can be found.

episodes.title: The Murderous Pottery Class (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Once the police arrive, Conan is able to reveal the culprit. Ran and Sonoko make pottery for their beloveds.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Passenger (Part One)
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys run into Jodie-sensei and Araide-sensei on a bus. Haiabara senses a member of the Black Organization on the bus when it is hijacked.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Passenger (Part Two)
episodes.summary: With Jodie's help, Conan is able to prevent the busjacking, but the bombs can't be stopped. After the bus is evacuated, Conan realizes there is still someone on the bus: Haibara!

episodes.title: The Falling from the Condo Case
episodes.summary: Conan and Kogoro are with a man when his roommate falls from their condo to his death. Was it coincidence or a clever murder?

episodes.title: The Evidence That Didn't Disappear (Part One)
episodes.summary: Professor Agasa takes the Detective Boys to a neighbor's. Someone appears to have stolen the neighbor's dog!

episodes.title: The Evidence That Didn't Disappear (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys search the house for clues for the missing dog. When the grandfather clock does not chime as inspected, it gets a closer look.

episodes.title: The Locked Wine Cellar
episodes.summary: A body turns up inside a locked wine cellar! How did the killer manage to get out of a room locked from the inside?

episodes.title: The Nanki Shirahama Mystery Tour (Part One)
episodes.summary: While on vacation in Shirahama, Conan and group meet students from an art club that do not seem to get along well.

episodes.title: The Nanki Shirahama Mystery Tour (Part Two)
episodes.summary: One of the art students is found stabbed in the heart. What is this art club group hiding?

episodes.title: The 3 "K"s of Osaka Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Heiji invites Conan to Osaka for the opening of a restaurant with many celebrities present. A gunshot rings out during the opening and a news reporter has been shot dead.

episodes.title: The 3 "K"s of Osaka Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: A boxer, a baseball player, and a soccer player. One of these three men shot the news reporter. What is bothering Conan?

episodes.title: The Shinkansen Transport Case (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan and Ran are returning from Osaka. Takagi and Sato are also on the train investigating a bomb.

episodes.title: The Shinkansen Transport Case (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The bomb was a decoy. A drug dealer is found murdered in the train bathroom. Takagi also struggles being with Sato as he wants to date her.

episodes.title: Boy Genta's Misfortune
episodes.summary: Genta is the target of a killer! The Detective Boys try to figure out why Genta is being targeted.

episodes.title: Kogoro Mouri's Imposter (Part One)
episodes.summary: An imposter of Kogoro's is found hung in his hotel room. Another body is found outside the hotel, but it has been there much longer. What is happening in this hotel?

episodes.title: Kogoro Mouri's Imposter (Part Two)
episodes.summary: After an embezzlement of funds and a double-crossing amongst thieves, Conan is able to wrap up the imposter mystery!

episodes.title: The Gunshot at the Sunflower Estate
episodes.summary: An architect is shot in the head, allegedly by a stalker. What do the other firm employees have to do with this?

episodes.title: The Mystery in the Net (Part One)
episodes.summary: Haibara and Ran are having issues getting along at the beach. A local fishermen group appears at the beach and later one of them washes up on shore in a net.

episodes.title: The Mystery in the Net (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The killer bumbles his testimony while speaking with the police and Conan catches on! Haibara and Ran improve their relationship.

episodes.title: The Alibi of the Soothing Forest
episodes.summary: In a place called the "Soothing Forest" there is a small village. The village chief is found dead, but everyone in the village has an alibi.

episodes.title: The Celebrities' Secret (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro is invited to, Yoko's friend's engagement with a famous actor. When Kogoro arrives, though, he is hit with a tennis racket by mistake! It turned out that Yoko's frind had been blackmailed by an unknown person, and had been very careful when opening doors since. While everyone is watching a video, Yoko's friend goes showering. After quite a time Conan realises that something must be wrong and goes into the bathroom to find Yoko's friend lying in the bathtub with her neck cut.

episodes.title: The Celebrities' Secret (Part Two)
episodes.summary: It turned out that Yoko's friend wasn't dead yet- she just suffered from a serious cut. The police arrived quickly (with Megure commenting one how easily Kogoro finds his job),but they couldn't find the murder weapon. All they found was a bloody trail leading to the back to and a bloodied coat. Thus they concluded that the attacker must be Yoko's friend's blackmailer, and was not one of the people watching the videotape. But Conan suspects that the murder weapon had been discarded cleverly. And he isn't going to give up until he finds the brutal killer!

episodes.title: The Tragedy at the OK Corral
episodes.summary: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro visit a horse farm. One of the men there dies – is a horse responsible?

episodes.title: The Kidnapper in the Picture
episodes.summary: The Detective Boys are on the hunt for a kidnapping clown! They must follow the clues left behind in order to save a 5 year old boy from his kidnapper.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 4 (Part One)
episodes.summary: Sato is having an arranged marriage meeting with a man due to her mother's persistence. She arrives to find out it's Ninzaburo Shiratori. She proposes that if Takagi does not arrive to her before sunset, she will marry him whether she wants to or not. He accepts, but Takagi is busy with a store robbery. Three of the eye witnesses all give different description and three culprits are kept in the back of the police car. Conan on the phone prepares to help Takagi solve the case as Kudo Shinichi.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 4 (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Takagi solves the case and arrests the culprit when he tries to make a dash out of the police car. Takagi catches up and gives up on going to Sato in time to stop the marriage as the sun is almost set and the car is too far away. His party comes to cheer him on and he runs. Conan manages to stop the marriage in time with Tomoaki Araide's help. Takagi manages to reach the restaurant but the sun has completely sunk. He then sees Sato around the corner who tells him he told her an emergency case has come up. Takagi smiles as he enters the car. Meanwhile Shiratori leaves the restaurant, disappointed in his close marriage. Conan comments how Takagi and Sato reminded him of Ran and himself.

episodes.title: The 14th Round of the Matsue Tamatsukuri Linked Verse Contest (Part One)
episodes.summary: After Kogoro wins a trip to Matsue, they meet a group holding a poetry contest. Soon enough, one of the members is beaten to death and every other member is not sad to see him dead.

episodes.title: The 14th Round of the Matsue Tamatsukuri Linked Verse Contest (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan has Kogoro take place in the Linked Verse contest to see how the culprit may reveal themself.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Punishment from Heaven
episodes.summary: A robber is found dead in a temple following an earthquake. However, the robber is stealing from a poor temple far from his home. Something is awry with this case.

episodes.title: The Man from Chicago (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan, Agasa, and the Detective Boys run into an old man named James Black who is being hassled by people, mistaking him for a celebrity. They help him get away and clear the confusion, but later, the man ends up getting kidnapped. Can Conan and the Detective Boys rescue him?

episodes.title: The Man from Chicago (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The kidnappers have apprehended a police car. Conan and the police force set off to rescue James Black and apprehend the thieves.

episodes.title: The Shaking Restaurant
episodes.summary: Due to nearby construction, a restaurant has been shaking constantly causing broken plates and glasses. When the owner is found dead the next day, it looks like an accident, but is it?

episodes.title: The Fearful Legend of the Snowy Night (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan get stranded on a snowy road on their way to a hot spring. They meet the Daimon family, who lets them stay the night, but the next morning one of them has been found dead.

episodes.title: The Fearful Legend of the Snowy Night (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The father and eldest brother have been killed. Is this the work of a 500-year-old samurai curse or something more nefarious?

episodes.title: The Osaka Double Mystery: The Naniwa Swordsman and Toyotomi's Castle
episodes.summary: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are coming to visit Osaka, hoping to see Heiji's kendo match, but he ends up involved in a murder incident and misses his tournament. Later on, Conan and Heiji help solve a 13-year old mystery that claims new victims involving the hunt for Ieyasu's secret gold.

episodes.title: Courtroom Confrontation: Kisaki vs. Kogoro (Part One)
episodes.summary: Eri Kirisaki takes a case that results in Kogoro being a key witness and alibi for the prime suspect. Will Eri win or does Kogoro provide a legitimate alibi?

episodes.title: Courtroom Confrontation: Kisaki vs. Kogoro (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The prosecutor turns the table on Eri when Kogoro's testimony is turned upside down. Can Kogoro find the evidence needed in time?

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Valentine's (The Case Part)
episodes.summary: Sonoko and Ran go to a house in the hills to make Valentine's chocolate. While there, the group runs into other patrons visiting for various reasons. Following a snowstorm, one of them is found dead.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Valentine's (The Deduction Part)
episodes.summary: The dead photographer's camera has droplets of blood on it, leading Conan to believe the murder took place before the snowstorm.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Valentine's (The Resolution Part)
episodes.summary: As Kogoro is unveiling the culprit, others reveal plans of their own!

episodes.title: The Forgotten Memento from the Crime (Part One)
episodes.summary: Kogoro passes up a case for finding a man's deceased wife's watch and the Detective Boys take it on. The search is put on pause when a murder takes place nearby.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Memento from the Crime (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan believes the client hired them to be his alibi. Takagi reveals important files have been stolen from the Metropolitan Police Department.

episodes.title: The Secret Rushed Omission (Part One)
episodes.summary: Ran is still puzzled by her run in with Shuichi Akai, feeling she has seen him before. Later, while Ran is in the mall with Conan, Sonoko, and Jodie a murder occurs.

episodes.title: The Secret Rushed Omission (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan needs to solve the dying message in order to find the culprit. The Black Organization is on the move.

episodes.title: Riddle Granny Disappearance Case
episodes.summary: Ayumi believes the old lady who feeds birds at the park has been kidnapped. The Detective Boy's set out to find her kidnappers.

episodes.title: The Truth of the Haunted House (Part One)
episodes.summary: While investigating a ghost case, Ran, Conan, and Kogoro stay the night at an apartment building. During the night, she sees a ghost on the TV screen! The water in the toilet turns red!

episodes.title: The Truth of the Haunted House (Part Two)
episodes.summary: The group learns two years' prior there had been a fire and one of the residents died. Conan determines the culprit's trick and who is behind the ghosts!

episodes.title: The Policeman's Missing Notebook Case
episodes.summary: Takagi breaks up a scuffle between a singer and their manager and loses his notebook in the process. Finding it out is not as easy when the Detective Boy's learn of a devious plan at hand.

episodes.title: English Teacher vs. Great Western Detective (Part One)
episodes.summary: Conan has Heiji investigate Jodie at her apartment building, but when one of her neighbors is thrown from the building, things change quickly.

episodes.title: English Teacher vs. Great Western Detective (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Conan and Heiji have Jodie assist them with the investigation, but they continue their investigation of her on their own.

episodes.title: Hooligan's Labyrinth (Part One)
episodes.summary: The group is watching a soccer match between the Tokyo Spirits and Noir. Following the game, a man is found stabbed inside a train.

episodes.title: Hooligan's Labyrinth (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Haibara is seen watching Higo, a soccer player, who's circumstances mimic her own. When Conan explains the situation, he realizes something about the crime.

episodes.title: The Small Witnesses
